walkthrough.title: Find risky SQL before it ships
walkthrough.description: Run your first local SQL analysis in under a minute.
step.0.title: Try a realistic SQL sample
step.0.description: Run [Open Interactive Sample](command:sqlAtlas.openSample) and see diagnostics directly in the editor.
step.1.title: Understand the findings
step.1.description: Open the Problems panel with [Show Problems](command:workbench.actions.view.problems). Each finding includes a rule ID and a concrete suggestion.
step.2.title: Match your database
step.2.description: Choose PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server or Oracle in [SQL Atlas Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%40ext%3AMilosz.sql-atlas).
config.sqlAtlas.language: Diagnostic language: automatic (VS Code UI language), English, or Polish.
config.sqlAtlas.minimumSeverity: Lowest finding severity shown in the editor.
config.sqlAtlas.ignoreRules: SQL Atlas rule IDs disabled for this workspace.
